title: To make use of the free open access publishing option with IGI Global and the Journal of Experimental Botany, the corresponding author has to be a member of ETH Zurich.
main_content:
To make use of the free open access publishing option with IGI Global and the Journal of Experimental Botany, the corresponding author has to be a member of ETH Zurich.

All , should you like to make use of this option.

Authors from subscribing institutions are eligible to publish open access free of charge in the Journal of Experimental Botany . As ETH member, you can profit from this offer too.

Further information on funding open access publications
